title: SS28 Women's Design and Production Innovations
summary: Design and production for SS28: modular construction, product data under the EU passport timeline, development booked around the January 2027 fairs.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Future Snoops' SS28 performance preview: "smart translucent membranes, hyperlight wovens, and innovative technical silks", ultrastretch wovens, modular constructions and articulated seams<sup>[1]</sup>
- The EU textiles Digital Product Passport delegated act is planned for the fourth quarter of 2027, so SS28 production is the first to be planned under it<sup>[2]</sup>
- Première Vision Paris presents SS28 collections on 26-28 January 2027<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body:
- Modular and articulated construction.
- Fibre and origin data per style.
- Sample at the fairs; confirm after the shows.

design_implications: - Record fibre, origin, care and test results for every style.
commercial_implications: - Plan production around Lunar New Year and EU product-data rules.
